summary: Iteration 7: Return Velocity widget + order_type filter. All 10 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend Overview shows the return-velocity-panel with correct headline (44.4%), correct Dresses top row (58.6% velocity, ₹88,599 leakage), row click drills to /calculations with all 4 URL params, drill button navigates with order_type=return_dto, calc page shows 5,443 return-DTO rows. No regressions on overview/commission-summary/recon-summary/health-score. Fundle badge and AI Insights both intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Overview.jsx is now 290 lines with many sections — still readable but approaching split threshold (KPI grid, subcat deep dive, monthly trend, return velocity, top recoverable, unmapped banner). Consider extracting <ReturnVelocityPanel/> into its own component for future maintainability.

return-velocity data-testid uses r.sub_category.replace(/\s+/g,'-') — works for single-word categories but subcategories with special chars (e.g., '&', '/') will still produce awkward testids. Consider slugify to keep selectors stable.

Backend return_velocity endpoint applies allowDiskUse=True but shares cache tag 'calculations' which is fine; the cache key includes the full match dict — a period_value change correctly busts the cache.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded 21,614 calc rows for 2026-04.
